name: jr.com
description: Dev-only dependency management for vendored front-end libraries and local build tooling. Jekyll never runs npm; see the "vendor" and "resume" scripts.

scripts.vendor:glightbox: mkdir -p assets/js/vendor assets/css/vendor && cp node_modules/glightbox/dist/js/glightbox.min.js assets/js/vendor/glightbox.min.js && cp node_modules/glightbox/dist/css/glightbox.min.css assets/css/vendor/glightbox.min.css
